title: Recent advances in luminescent lanthanide based Single-Molecule Magnets
claim: Dipolar interactions generally enhance QTM by generating a transverse field, whereas exchange can either suppress tunnelling, as in strongly coupled radical-bridged dimers, or enhance it when inequivalent lanthanide sites create a local transverse field.
explanation: The review states that the role of dipolar and exchange coupling in polynuclear SMMs is not yet generalizable. Exchange-reduced QTM is illustrated by the dinitrogen-radical dinuclear complex with coercivity up to 14 K, while polyheteronuclear complexes with non-equivalent sites show faster relaxation.
conditions: Presence of dipolar and/or exchange coupling between spin carriers.
caveats: The authors explicitly say the situation is not fully understood and generalization is difficult.
